product_metadata.title: Old World Christmas Swedish Dala Horse Glass Blown Ornaments for Christmas Tree
features: HAND-CRAFTED: Our Christmas Ornaments have been hand-crafted using age-old traditions that originated in the 1800s to bring you the highest quality ornaments for your tree
Our Swedish Dala Horse Glass Ornament will add a beautiful,elegant touch to any Christmas tree or to accent the decorations within your home
GIFT: Over the years the hand carved and painted Dala Horse has become a symbol of authentic Swedish handicraft and one of Sweden's most popular souvenirs
QUALITY: These Christmas tree ornaments are hand-painted and mouth-blown to provide you with a beautifully crafted and high-quality ornament
FESTIVE: Our hand crafted glass blown ornaments give your tree the holiday sparkle it needs
